_comment: Team roster for commit authorship on shared computers.
An agent session reads this, asks the student at the keyboard which entry is theirs,
and commits with: git -c user.name="<name>" -c user.email="<email>" commit -m "..."
email must be the GitHub no-reply address for the account, so GitHub links the commit
to that profile without publishing a real address. Find it at GitHub -> Settings -> Emails;
